story_name: Odin's Sacrifice: The Price of Wisdom
character_description: Odin, Norse all-father with one blazing eye that sees all timelines, flowing silver beard adorned with runes glowing with ancient magic. Wears deep blue cloak that seems to contain starlight. Eternal seeker sacrificing endlessly for knowledge—bearing both power and profound weariness.
setting: Yggdrasil the World Tree and Nine Realms beyond
theme: The cost of wisdom and continuous sacrifice for understanding

video_prompts: Odin stands at base of Yggdrasil, blazing eye surveying all Nine Realms simultaneously. He contemplates latest sacrifice needed for greater wisdom.
first_frame_prompt: Odin stands before Yggdrasil's immense roots, ancient and eternal. His single blazing eye scans infinite timelines, glowing with knowledge and burden. Silver beard adorned with runes pulses with accumulated magic. His deep blue cloak streams with starlight energy. The weariness of infinite sacrifice visible in his posture.
speech: What wisdom remains undiscovered that I must sacrifice for?
